meta.description: Download large datasets from NCBI efficiently using EPost, history server, batching, rate limiting, and retry logic.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: Live NCBI and Datasets outputs are labelled with their observed counts; network-free resume tests use synthetic local fixtures.

practice_boundaries.detail: This is data-retrieval engineering and makes no diagnostic or patient-facing claim.

methodological_ground.detail: The route selection, rate cap, history-server recovery, and integrity checks were exercised at their boundaries.

code_usability.detail: All three source examples, the source regression suite, forged-WebEnv recovery, zero-hit guard, EPost boundary, and EDirect block executed successfully.

functional_suitability.note: Direct, history, EPost, Datasets, EDirect, checkpoint, and integrity routes are actionable.

reliability.note: Committed tests cover byte-exact resume, old checkpoints, zero results, bytes/str, error bodies, and completed checkpoints.

performance_context.note: The table-driven Skill remains compact despite necessary failure-mode detail.

agent_usability.note: Record-count thresholds, hard stops, rate caps, and alternatives are explicit.

human_usability.note: Examples and common-error entries directly map symptoms to recovery.

security.note: No hard-coded real credential or user-input execution path was found.

maintainability.note: Source tests lock the silent-corruption fixes; external NCBI response-shape drift remains inherently live-service dependent.

agent_specific.note: The Skill precisely distinguishes soft >100K guidance from the >1M or entire-database hard stop.

inputs.label: Source batch_by_ids.py direct and chained fetch
inputs.execution_note: Executed the pinned source example from a non-source working directory; direct EFetch returned 6/6 records and chained EPost returned 255/255.
inputs.note: Both source paths completed with the documented 200+55 post split.

inputs.label: Source checkpointed_download forged WebEnv
inputs.execution_note: Imported the pinned source robust_download.py, forged its first query key against a real BRCA1 history session, and recovered 368 records with no remaining checkpoint.
inputs.note: The source decodes the real HTTP-200 ERROR body, refreshes history, and completes.

inputs.label: Pinned-source 200/201-ID EPost boundary
inputs.execution_note: Executed source functions on 200 and 201 live IDs: direct_efetch recovered 200, refused 201, and chained_epost_fetch recovered 201.
inputs.note: The advertised EPost boundary is enforced and recoverable.

inputs.label: PubMed MEDLINE history-server workflow
inputs.execution_note: Executed the documented CRISPR AND 2024[PDAT] workflow for 1,000 of live Count=8,768 records; all 1,000 parsed with non-empty titles.
inputs.note: Chunked history retrieval completes without record loss.

inputs.label: Pinned-source robust_download.py live run
inputs.execution_note: Executed the unmodified pinned source example in a non-source directory; it wrote 368 BRCA1 records with zero CRLF sequences and 31,994 LF endings.
inputs.note: The example is live-runnable and preserves payload newlines.

inputs.label: Genome and species-bulk route
inputs.execution_note: Executed static source checks for the Datasets accession/taxon rows and ran source batch_fasta.py with the opt-in Datasets route; INS returned 4 records and GCF_009858895.2 downloaded as 22,246 bytes.
inputs.note: Genome-scale requests are routed to Datasets rather than an unsupported EFetch loop.

inputs.label: Entire database with 20 workers
inputs.execution_note: Executed source-text boundary checks: the >1,000,000 or literal entire-database row refuses an EFetch loop and the worker cap is four with an API key or one without.
inputs.note: The extreme-scale request is explicitly refused and routed to bulk alternatives.

inputs.label: Pinned-source zero-hit guard
inputs.execution_note: Executed source history_server_download() on a genuine nonsense-gene Count=0 query; it returned sentinel 0 and created no output file.
inputs.note: The guard is real rather than hidden by the example's non-zero query.

inputs.label: 800,000-record sub-threshold request
inputs.execution_note: Executed source-text boundary checks: 800,000 falls under the >100,000 soft FTP/Datasets guidance and does not invoke the >1,000,000 hard refusal.
inputs.note: The hard-stop threshold does not over-trigger below one million.

key_strengths: Source-level resume and payload-integrity regressions are network-free and pass.
Live source routes recover WebEnv expiry, preserve LF payloads, and enforce EPost boundaries.
Dataset-scale decisions explicitly reject unsafe EFetch loops and route genome bulk to Datasets.
